publication: S. P. Lalley, Continuous Martingales I. Fundamentals, 25 October 2016
reviewed: Section 3.2, complete Proposition 2 statement and proof, printed page 5/PDF index 4; progressive measurability context in Section 2
comparison: Classical bounded optional sampling by upper finite grids, right continuity and conditional uniform integrability. The cited version is stated under a standard filtration. This paper supplies its own explicit original-natural-filtration progressive/stopped proof and specialized Poisson majorants; the generic native source theorem retains its exact hypotheses.
limits: Not a new optional-sampling theorem or a full review of optional-sampling literature. The argument and majorants are for a fixed finite process and deterministic bounded horizon only.
